title: browserDeviceKeys
responsibility: Keeps one device key pair per account and computer in browser storage, so a reload reconnects as the same device.

inputs.name: browserDeviceKeys.actor
inputs.description: Verified account id the keys belong to; another account never reuses them.

inputs.name: browserDeviceKeys.hostId
inputs.description: Identifier of the linked computer the browser presents the keys to.

outputs.name: browserDeviceKeys
outputs.description: The stored P-256 key pair, or a fresh one when browser storage is unavailable or empty.
